variety_description: Early maturity, medium height, long slender, high yielding and widely adaptable variety grown in India under irrigated lowland and upland conditions. Drought tolerant variety with good adaptability in water scarce conditions. Yield advantage of around 1.0 mt/ha over other varieties of similar maturity under drought stress conditions. Developed by IIRR &amp; IRRI and released in 2016 for cultivation in the Southern and Central India. Tolerant to lodging and grain shattering. Excellent grain and eating quality.
